jobs.description:
Since its founding in 1891, a culture of continuous innovation has made our client one of the world's leading manufacturers of heavy trucks and buses.

It's unique modular product system, developed over several decades, is one of our key success factors. It is an integral part of our flexible approach and lies at the heart of our business model.

Jobomschrijving

You will independently perform maintenance and repair work on our fleet of vehicles, including trucks and buses.
You'll work with a premium brand, and we’ll turn you into a true specialist in your field!

You’ll join a close team of experienced technicians, all working together toward one goal: providing fast and efficient service to our customers.

We are looking for a passionate mechanic with:
	
• Technical training (A2 or bachelor's degree) in automotive mechanics, electricity, or truck technology.	
•  	
• Knowledge of or experience with heavy vehicles such as trucks, agricultural vehicles, or forklifts.	
•  	
• The ability to work independently.	
•  	
• The motivation to continuously learn through our training programs.	
•  	
• You speak good Dutch or good English.

Our client is an international environmental services company dedicated to protecting the planet with sustainable mobile filtration solutions for liquids and gases.

They have approximately 450 employees, united as Generation D., all committed to driving positive ecological change across various industries.

Jobomschrijving

What does a Process Operator ?

Quality responsibility – You ensure the optimal production of high-quality reactivated carbon by precisely adjusting process parameters to maintain excellent production output.

Operational responsibility – You start up, operate, monitor, and shut down various technical installations to ensure uninterrupted production.

Problem-solving – When technical malfunctions occur, you analyze the cause and perform necessary repairs or adjustments to maintain production efficiency.

Process optimization – You actively contribute ideas for improvements to enhance efficiency and sustainability in production processes.

Forklift operation – You will use a forklift for various tasks, ensuring a smooth and safe production process.

Why You?

Are you ready to work in a dynamic and innovative environment where you can continuously contribute to improvements? Then you might be the perfect candidate!

 

Your Team as a Process Operator

You will join a fantastic team of technical operators and forklift drivers in Rumbeke, reporting directly to your team lead.

Who Are We Looking For?
	
• A strong technical background (mechanics, electricity, etc.) and a passion for technology and innovation.	
• Fluent in English and/or Dutch.	
• Forklift certification required.	
• Analytical and problem-solving skills – You can quickly detect and resolve technical issues.	
• Hands-on mentality – You are proactive and not afraid to get your hands dirty.	
• Team player – You can work well in a team but are also capable of working independently.	
• Flexibility – Willing to work in a shift system.	
• Safety-conscious – You always prioritize safety and strictly follow procedures.	
• Even if you don’t meet all the criteria but strongly identify with our core values – Teamwork, Excellence, and Devotion – we encourage you to apply!

About the Company

Our client is a leading logistics partner for the frozen food sector, serving industries, retailers, and foodservice companies. The company offers specialized frozen storage, inventory management, and logistics solutions, and is known for its stable operations, strong growth, and focus on employee wellbeing.

Jobomschrijving

Are you a hands-on person who enjoys physical work and thrives in a dynamic warehouse environment? Are you accurate, motivated, and not afraid of working in cold temperatures? Then this opportunity is for you!

For a stable and international logistics company in Oostkamp, specialized in frozen food storage and distribution, we are looking for motivated Order Pickers to strengthen the team.

Your tasks include:
	
• Picking orders using a voice-picking system or scanner	
• Checking products for quality and quantity	
• Preparing orders for shipment	
• Operating a standing Electric Pallet Truck (EPT)	
• Handling goods in a frozen warehouse environment (-22°C)

We are looking for candidates who:
	
• Have experience as an Order Picker 	
• Have experience operating an Electric Pallet Truck (EPT)	
• Are physically fit and enjoy active work	
• Work accurately and follow instructions carefully	
• Speak English or Dutch	
• Are reliable, motivated, and looking for long-term employment	
• Are comfortable working in a frozen environment (-22°C)

Our client is a well-established company operating in all segments of passenger transport, including public transport, school and company transport, and coach tourism services. With multiple locations across Belgium and Luxembourg, they are looking for a skilled Bus Mechanic to strengthen their garage team in Affligem or Lede.

Jobomschrijving

 

Your Responsibilities
	
• Independently perform both simple and complex mechanical and electrical repairs and installations on buses.	
• Carry out preventive maintenance and diagnostics.	
• Report all maintenance and repair work accurately using the company's garage application.	
• Take the lead when necessary and provide support and guidance to fellow technicians.	
• Participate in technical training courses provided by various bus manufacturers.

You have a solid technical background in vehicle mechanics.

You have knowledge of vehicle electronics and can read electrical diagrams.

You are passionate about technology and work accurately, safely, and independently.

You hold a technical secondary education (TSO) diploma in Automotive Technology or have equivalent experience.

You are proactive, able to identify technical issues, and find effective solutions.

You communicate well in English, Dutch, or French.

Experience with the maintenance of suspension systems, brakes, filters, and general vehicle servicing is required.

Experience working on trucks is an advantage; experience with buses is even better.

A Category B driving licence is considered an asset, as occasional roadside assistance may be required.

Our client is the world's largest vertically integrated manufacturer of polyurethane foams. The company serves a diverse global marketplace with innovative polyurethane chemical solutions, polyester fibers, and insulation materials. With a network of more than 60 production facilities worldwide, our client has established itself as a global industry leader, recognized for its high-quality products, advanced manufacturing technologies, and commitment to employee development.

Jobomschrijving

As a Machine Operator, you will be responsible for:
	
• Operating and setting up production machines according to production guidelines and specifications.	
• Cutting and processing foam blocks based on customer and production requirements.	
• Performing quality checks on finished products, including dimensions, shape, color, and compliance with specifications.	
• Using measuring tools during the production process.	
• Registering production data and labeling products in the Carpy system.	
• Transporting materials and products between workstations using an electric pallet truck.	
• Ensuring the proper operation of machinery and carrying out basic maintenance tasks when required.

Requirements
	
• Previous experience in a production or manufacturing environment.	
• Technical aptitude and an interest in operating machinery.	
• Ability to work independently with a strong sense of responsibility and attention to quality.	
• Good teamwork and communication skills.	
• Working knowledge of English or Dutch sufficient for workplace communication.

Our client has over 100 years of expertise in cleaning and renting high-quality textiles. They provide their services to hospitals, healthcare institutions, and holiday parks in both the Netherlands and Belgium. Known for being accessible, nearby, and highly engaged, they are dedicated to delivering exceptional service and maintaining strong relationships with their clients. Joining their team means contributing to a legacy of excellence and reliability in the textile industry.

Jobomschrijving

Are you an experienced Driver with a passion for delivering excellent service? Our client is looking for dedicated Drivers to join their team in Oedelem (Oostkamp/Bruges). This is an exciting opportunity to work with a company that values reliability, professionalism, and teamwork.

Main Responsibilities:
	
• Operate vehicles (C and CE licenses) on fixed routes from Monday to Friday.	
• Drive 50% of the time and assist with loading/unloading 50% of the time.	
• Ensure timely and safe delivery of goods.	
• Handle physically demanding tasks, including moving heavy carts.	
• Maintain clear communication and adhere to schedules.

Profile Description

Our client is seeking Drivers who meet the following criteria:
	
• Valid C or CE driving license, medical clearance, and Code 95 certification.	
• Excellent command of Dutch, French, or English.	
• Physically fit and capable of handling heavy loads.	
• Reliable, with a strong work ethic and minimal absenteeism.	
• Able to provide good references.

About the Company:

Our client, headquartered in Zwijnaarde, is a leading global biotechnology company introducing groundbreaking cell therapy to Ghent. Their dedicated team plays a crucial role in improving the lives of patients battling cancer and other severe illnesses. As they continue to grow, they are looking for motivated and committed individuals to join their dynamic workforce.

Jobomschrijving

For our client, an innovative and rapidly expanding biotech company, we are currently seeking a Warehouse Associate.

Responsibilities:

As a Warehouse Associate, you will be responsible for:
	
• Handling biohazard materials such as blood bags and viral vectors in a temperature-controlled environment.	
• Accurately processing incoming inventory by verifying purchase orders, conducting quality checks, and ensuring compliance with company policies.	
• Managing equipment and materials stored at cryogenic temperatures.	
• Completing Master Inspection Checks (MIC) for received goods, including transportation inspections, temperature control, integrity verification, and proper documentation.	
• Filling in necessary forms and logbooks related to receiving, picking, and outbound operations in accordance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Documentation Practices (GDP).	
• Collaborating closely with the Operations and Quality departments to facilitate production and laboratory activities at the start-up site.	
• Working in a sterile environment while wearing specialized protective clothing.	
• Using two SAP Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems to manage inbound, picking, and outbound logistics.	
• Coordinating with accounting, suppliers, and business stakeholders to enhance operational efficiency.

Candidate Profile:
	
• High school diploma or associate’s degree.	
• Prior warehouse experience, preferably within the pharmaceutical industry.	
• Strong attention to detail with the ability to complete administrative tasks such as filling out forms and maintaining logbooks.	
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively across various levels of the organization.	
• Problem-solving mindset with solid analytical and data interpretation skills.	
• Strict adherence to protocols to ensure product quality and personal safety at all times.	
• Ability to work independently while maintaining a high level of responsibility.	
• Proficiency in English is essential.

Our client is building one of the most advanced glass factories in the world in Lommel. This ultramodern site excels in sustainability, automation, and technological innovation. As a TECHNICIAN, you play a key role in the maintenance and operation of this state-of-the-art production environment, where safety, efficiency, and environmental awareness are at the forefront.

Jobomschrijving

Well before the startup, you will begin thorough training in day shifts to fully understand our installations, systems, and standards, enabling you to help set the standard in this unique factory from day one.

Depending on your background (electrical or mechanical), you will be deployed as a technician within one of the teams. Your tasks will include:
	
• Maintenance and monitoring of electrical systems, such as switchboards, electrical installations, and emergency repairs;	
• Supervision of gas installations, ensuring safety and proper functioning of these systems;	
• Maintenance of HVAC systems (Heating, Ventilation, Air Conditioning), ensuring adequate temperature and air quality in buildings;	
• Diagnostics and repair of heating systems.

Profile:
	
• You have completed technical training and have relevant experience 	
• You are strong in mechanical and/or electrical areas	
• You are solution-oriented and enjoy working in a team	
• You are skilled in reading technical plans or schematics	
• You can work in a 6-shift system and are looking for a stable, long-term challenge	
• You speak good English.

An SME in the Waasland region known for the production, purchase, and sale of pallets.

Jobomschrijving

For our client in Lokeren, we are looking for a motivated Pallet Repair Worker to join a stable and growing company. You will work in a modern pallet repair line during the day shift, where quality, safety, and teamwork are essential.

Your responsibilities
	
• Repair damaged wooden pallets according to EPAL quality standards.	
• Use a pneumatic nail gun to attach boards and blocks.	
• Replace damaged pallet components, such as boards and blocks.	
• Inspect pallets for quality, dimensions, and compliance with EPAL standards.	
• Check chamfered edges and the overall condition of the pallets.	
• Sort pallets based on their condition and repair requirements.	
• Keep your workplace safe, clean, and well organized.	
• Work closely with your colleagues to ensure an efficient production process.

Who are we looking for?
	
• Experience in a production, woodworking, or logistics environment is an advantage, but motivated candidates willing to learn are also welcome.	
• You enjoy hands-on, physical work.	
• You work accurately and pay attention to quality and detail.	
• You can safely use hand tools and machinery.	
• You can work independently as well as in a team.	
• You have a good command of English to communicate on the work floor.	
• You are reliable, motivated, and responsible.

Company located in Roeselare

Jobomschrijving

You will be responsible for:
	
• Moving and dragging foam blocks	
• Manually feeding the machine	
• Picking up foam scraps from the floor	
• Keeping the workplace clean and organized	
• Working together with your colleague to ensure a smooth production process

	
• You speak Dutch or English.	
• You are physically strong and enjoy active work.	
• You can perform repetitive tasks accurately.	
• You enjoy working together with a colleague.	
• Experience is not required; motivation is more important.	
• You can work in a day shift, and when production volumes increase, you are willing to work in a 2-shift system.

The company is located in an area with no traffic jams

Jobomschrijving

What does the role involve?
	
• As an operator, you are responsible for the accurate execution of production processes.	
• You precisely measure materials.	
• You perform calculations and ensure everything runs according to plan.	
• You work in an environment where quality and precision are key.

Profile – What do we expect from you?
	
• Strong numerical skills and the ability to measure accurately.	
• Good spatial awareness.	
• Fluency in Dutch or very good proficiency in English.	
• Flexibility: you work in day shifts, but are willing to switch to a two-shift system during peak workload.	
• Careful and correct working method, with strong attention to detail.

Company Activities

Our client is a leader in the travel bag, luggage, and accessories industry, known for combining style with cutting-edge design technology and a commitment to quality and durability. With over a century of heritage, they offer unparalleled products that meet the needs of travelers worldwide. Their brands are sold in over 100 countries, providing a diverse and inclusive work environment that values sustainability and innovation.

 

Jobomschrijving

Are you ready to take your career to the next level as a Mold Technician? Our client is seeking a skilled and motivated individual to join their team in Oudenaarde. As a Mold Technician, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the smooth operation and maintenance of molds used in production.

Key Responsibilities:
	
• Independently assemble, disassemble, and maintain molds to ensure they are production-ready.	
• Repair hydraulic cylinders and create flexible hoses for hydraulic and gas applications.	
• Conduct fine mechanical work and apply simple sandblast structures.	
• Diagnose and propose technical improvements for defective molds.	
• Occasionally engage in turning, milling, and grinding tasks with training provided when necessary.

Profile Description

The ideal candidate for the Mold Technician role possesses:
	
• A Bachelor’s degree in electromechanics or an A2 in mechanics with a minimum of 5 years of experience in a similar position.	
• Experience in a production environment, especially in machining operations such as turning, grinding, and milling.	
• Strong technical insight and a passion for mechanics.	
• Basic knowledge of electricity.	
• Resilience under pressure and willingness to work in a two-shift system after the training period.	
• Good knowledge of English or Dutch.

About the Company:

Our client is a respected organization where quality, safety, and teamwork are core values. As a VCA**-certified company, they are committed to providing excellent service to their clients while fostering a growth-oriented and supportive environment for their employees. They are looking for individuals who share their passion for excellence and innovation.

Jobomschrijving

At our client’s company, quality and safety are at the heart of everything they do (VCA**-certified). Equally important, however, are their people. Due to their continued growth, they are looking for a motivated Industrial Electrician to make a real difference within their organization.

Your Role:
	
• Perform on-site interventions at the client’s location in case of issues.	
• Take responsibility for repairing reported problems at the client’s site.	
• Verify that the actions taken result in the optimal functioning of the equipment.	
• Ensure all work is delivered with a focus on safety, efficiency, quality, and timing.	
• Act as the main point of contact for the client on-site and provide internal reports to the project manager.	
• Collaborate effectively, whether working independently or as part of a team.

Profile Description: 

A technical education in an electrical field (or equivalent through experience).

Strong communication skills in Dutch or English.

A customer-friendly attitude: You prioritize client values and ensure commitments are met.

A flexible mindset: You adapt your approach as needed to achieve goals and handle changes effectively.

A valid driver’s license (Category B).

VCA and BA4/5 certifications are a plus, but not mandatory.

Our client specializes in bodywork and mechanical repairs for all car brands.

Jobomschrijving

Our client is looking for a skilled tinsmith to join their team. You will be responsible for the repair, maintenance, and installation of metal components. As a tinsmith you will play a key role in restoring and repairing vehicles or metal structures.

 

Your Responsibilities:
	
• Performing sheet metal work, including repairing damaged parts.	
• Installing and removing body panels, metal coverings, or structural components.	
• Metal processing (bending, straightening, cutting, welding).	
• Preparing surfaces for painting or further treatment.	
• Following safety regulations and maintaining a clean workspace.

Candidate Profile:
	
• Minimum 2 years of experience as a tinsmith.	
• Proficiency in using sheet metal tools (hammers, welding machines, grinders, etc.).	
• Knowledge of materials and techniques used in sheet metal work.	
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.	
• Attention to detail and precision in executing tasks.	
• Communicative knowledge of English or Dutch.

Company Activities:

Our client is part of the circular economy based on wood fibers. In Belgium, the company has three units employing around 600 employees. The plant in Langerbrugge (Ghent) produces high-quality newspaper and magazine paper from 100% recycled paper. Thanks to two biomass power plants that provide the necessary process steam and three wind turbines, the company is one of the most sustainable enterprises in North Sea Port. Safety is the top priority, and thanks to intensive training programs, employees develop both professionally and personal

Jobomschrijving

Our client, a leading global producer of renewable solutions for paper, packaging, pulp, and wood constructions, is looking for an Electrical Maintenance Technician. In this role, you will be responsible for managing and maintaining the electrical network up to a voltage level of 150 kV.

Your daily tasks will include:
	
• Managing the lighting network.	
• Maintaining fire detection systems.	
• Operating frequency converters (ABB, Siemens, Danfoss).	
• Controlling various types of power switches (Siemens, ABB).

The ideal candidate should:
	
• Hold a Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent experience.	
• Have several years of experience in a similar role in an industrial production environment.	
• Be passionate about electricity and keep up-to-date with the latest trends in the field.	
• Think pragmatically and solve problems.	
• Plan and organize work effectively, with a focus on achieving results.	
• Communicate in English or Dutch at a good level.

Company Activities:

Join a company committed to excellence in maritime operations. Our client prides themselves on their dedication to safety, innovation, and teamwork. Their mission is to deliver top-notch dredging services with a focus on environmental sustainability and client satisfaction. As part of their team, you’ll be contributing to projects that shape the waterways of northern Europe, ensuring they remain navigable and efficient for all maritime traffic.

Jobomschrijving

Are you a skilled Captain for Tugboat looking for an exciting opportunity to showcase your expertise? Join our client’s dynamic team and navigate the waters of northern France and Belgium. Your primary mission will be to provide essential support to a dredging pontoon, ensuring smooth operations and safe passage through these regions.

Key Responsibilities:
	
• Navigate and operate the tugboat efficiently in collaboration with dredging operations.	
• Ensure the mechanical upkeep of the tugboat, supported by the client’s team of technicians.	
• Maintain tidiness and order on board, ensuring a safe and pleasant environment.	
• Coordinate with French-speaking and Flemish-speaking teams to ensure seamless communication and operations.

Profile Description:

Our client is seeking an independent and responsible individual to take on the role of Captain for Tugboat. The ideal candidate will possess:
	
• A strong mechanical knowledge, essential for the maintenance and operation of the tugboat.	
• CRR holder credentials.	
• A driving licence and access to a car for easy mobility.	
• A B licence (river) and A licence (river + coastal) to navigate various waterways.	
• Proficiency in English, French, or Dutch to effectively communicate with diverse teams.

Our client specializes in dredging works. They provide dredging and maintenance services for waterways, ports and coastlines. Their scope of work includes sediment removal, land reclamation, and improving navigability.

Jobomschrijving

Work location: The company headquarters is located in Zwijnaarde; projects are in the Ghent area
? Accommodation is not provided

Are you an experienced formwork carpenter? Or maybe you don’t have experience yet but are eager to learn? Is safety and quality your priority? If so, our client is looking for you!

Job Description:

We are looking for Formwork Carpenters to work on various construction projects. The person in this role will be responsible for assembling and dismantling formwork used to shape concrete structural elements.

Responsibilities:

• Preparation, assembly and dismantling of traditional and system formwork (e.g., Peri, Doka).
• Carrying out reinforcement and formwork according to technical drawings.
• Quality control of completed formwork and ensuring compliance with the project specifications.
• Close cooperation with other team members and the site manager.
• Ensuring workplace safety and compliance with health and safety regulations.

Requirements:

• Ability to read technical drawings.
• Experience as a formwork carpenter or construction worker, welder, or fitter.
• Communicative knowledge of English, Dutch, or French.
• Ability to work in a team and independently perform assigned tasks.
• VCA certificate is an advantage.
• Category B driving licence.

Our client is a leading Belgian dealer and service partner for commercial vehicles, vans, and trucks, with multiple locations across East and West Flanders, including Brugge, Ardooie, Bavikhove, Deinze, and Aalter. The company is known for its expertise, customer-focused approach, and commitment to quality service.

Jobomschrijving

We are looking for a Diagnostic Technician to join a growing and stable automotive company specializing in vans and trucks. Brand experience is not important. What matters most is your diagnostic knowledge and ability to identify and solve technical issues efficiently.

As a Diagnostic Technician, you will be responsible for:
	
• Performing advanced mechanical, electrical and electronic diagnostics on vans and trucks using diagnostic equipment and vehicle software.	
• Identifying faults and determining the most efficient repair strategy.	
• Repairing and adjusting mechanical, electrical and electronic systems based on diagnostic findings.	
• Communicating diagnostic results and completed repairs clearly to workshop management and service advisors.

Candidate Profile
	
• Passion for automotive technology and troubleshooting.	
• Technical education in automotive engineering, mechanics, electricity, or equivalent practical experience.	
• Good knowledge of vehicle diagnostics and diagnostic software.	
• Experience with diagnostic equipment is required.	
• Experience with a specific vehicle brand is not necessary.	
• Experience with vans, commercial vehicles or trucks is an advantage.	
• HEV1 certificate is a plus.	
• Analytical, accurate and problem-solving mindset.	
• Candidates must be able to communicate in Dutch or English.

About the company:

Our client, based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology company introducing innovative CAR-T cell therapy. Their team is making a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases. They are currently in a strong growth phase and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

Our client, a leading biotechnology company, is looking for individuals interested in joining their team as a Support Operator/Laboratory Disinfection Specialist.

Before you join their professional team, you will receive thorough training in aseptic (germ-free) work, GMP, and related procedures. As a support operator, you will be responsible for maintaining the assigned areas and production zones in the laboratory in spotless condition. With the utmost precision, you will ensure the maintenance of equipment used, and the cleanliness and disinfection of materials. You will handle cleaning agents and materials safely and correctly. The laboratory works with biological products in a strictly controlled environment where your attention to detail can impact human lives.

 

Step into the world of biotechnology and become part of a dynamic team!

Profile:

• Cleanliness and order are very important to you.

• Experience in a sterile environment is a plus.

• You are enthusiastic about teamwork and can work well both independently and in a group.

• You are highly proficient in English.

• You have at least basic knowledge of MS Office (as a large part of the job involves recording, reporting, and online training).

• Wearing a sterile suit and strictly following procedures is no problem for you.

Our client is building one of the most advanced glass factories in the world in Lommel. This ultramodern site excels in sustainability, automation, and technological innovation. As a TECHNICIAN, you play a key role in the maintenance and operation of this state-of-the-art production environment, where safety, efficiency, and environmental awareness are at the forefront.

Jobomschrijving

Well before the startup, you will begin thorough training in day shifts to fully understand our installations, systems, and standards, enabling you to help set the standard in this unique factory from day one.

Depending on your background (electrical or mechanical), you will be deployed as a technician within one of the maintenance teams. Your tasks will include:
	
• Analyzing and resolving technical faults in machines and installations	
• Performing preventive and corrective maintenance	
• Calibrating, adjusting, and checking parts and systems	
• Contributing ideas for technical improvements within your department	
• Working closely with fellow technicians and operators for safe and stable operation	
• Accurately recording interventions in the maintenance system

Profile:
	
• You have completed technical training or have relevant experience in maintenance	
• You are strong in mechanical and/or electrical areas	
• You are solution-oriented and enjoy working in a team	
• You are skilled in reading technical plans or schematics	
• You can work in a day-shift and are looking for a stable, long-term challenge	
• You speak good English.
